remarks: Set within the beautifully landscaped Winnipauk Village community, this immaculate 2-bedroom, 1-bath ranch style condo offers a thoughtful layout and access to fantastic amenities (including brand new pickle ball courts!) Ideally located just minutes from Norwalk's Post Road-with easy access to shopping, the train, and major highways-this home is also tucked into the peaceful, residential feel of the West Rocks neighborhood. The updated eat-in kitchen features wraparound countertops and generous cabinet space, opening to a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace and sliding doors that lead to a private patio-perfect for outdoor dining or relaxing in warmer months. Both bedrooms offer ample closet space and are separated by a full bathroom. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry with a stackable washer and dryer, a utility closet, and a large coat closet for extra storage. Residents also enjoy access to the community pool, clubhouse, and fitness center, as well as one assigned parking spot (#95) and plenty of visitor parking. Come see this turnkey condo and enjoy all it has to offer!
